name: VirusHunterGatherer
title: VirusHunterGatherer: a two-stage Snakemake pipeline for data-driven virus discovery
description: Snakemake workflow that performs profile HMM-based homology search for viral reads (Virushunter) followed by seed-based iterative genome assembly (Virusgatherer); ships with a dedicated RNA virus pHMM profile set alongside small and large DNA virus profile sets.
